rows.label: Finding
rows.value: Reported selected annual operands match the retained IPO and later annual comparatives. Available reported interim operands match retained periodic editions. No selected-line correction or non-reliance declaration was identified in the reviewed full-body accounting and correction disclosures.

rows.label: Limit
rows.value: Conditional restatement/control risks and clawback policy are not actual corrections. Certificate/MOU restatements, share conversions and fund tax reclassifications have distinct scopes. Generic immaterial reclassification wording alone does not prove unchanged revenue or operating income; exact statement comparisons supply the selected-line evidence. Auditor opinions cover financial statements, not internal-control assurance. The referenced 2023 former-auditor letter is not treated as reviewed assurance.

rows.value: Reported selected annual operands match the retained IPO and later annual comparatives. Available reported interim operands match retained periodic editions. rows.label: Limit
rows.value: Conditional restatement/control risks and clawback policy are not actual corrections. Certificate/MOU restatements, share conversions and fund tax reclassifications have distinct scopes. Generic immaterial reclassification wording alone does not prove unchanged revenue or operating income; exact statement comparisons supply the selected-line evidence. rows.value: Reported selected annual operands match the retained IPO and later annual comparatives. Available reported interim operands match retained periodic editions. rows.label: Limit
rows.value: Conditional restatement/control risks and clawback policy are not actual corrections. Certificate/MOU restatements, share conversions and fund tax reclassifications have distinct scopes. Generic immaterial reclassification wording alone does not prove unchanged revenue or operating income; exact statement comparisons supply the selected-line evidence. rows.label: Finding
rows.value: Reported selected annual operands match the retained IPO and later annual comparatives. Available reported interim operands match retained periodic editions. No selected-line correction or non-reliance declaration was identified in the reviewed full-body accounting and correction disclosures.

rows.label: Limit
rows.value: Conditional restatement/control risks and clawback policy are not actual corrections. Certificate/MOU restatements, share conversions and fund tax reclassifications have distinct scopes. Generic immaterial reclassification wording alone does not prove unchanged revenue or operating income; exact statement comparisons supply the selected-line evidence. Auditor opinions cover financial statements, not internal-control assurance. The referenced 2023 former-auditor letter is not treated as reviewed assurance.

rows.label: Finding
rows.value: Reported selected annual operands match the retained IPO and later annual comparatives. Available reported interim operands match retained periodic editions. No selected-line correction or non-reliance declaration was identified in the reviewed full-body accounting and correction disclosures.

rows.label: Limit
rows.value: Conditional restatement/control risks and clawback policy are not actual corrections. Certificate/MOU restatements, share conversions and fund tax reclassifications have distinct scopes. Generic immaterial reclassification wording alone does not prove unchanged revenue or operating income; exact statement comparisons supply the selected-line evidence. Auditor opinions cover financial statements, not internal-control assurance. The referenced 2023 former-auditor letter is not treated as reviewed assurance.

rows.label: Limit
rows.value: Conditional restatement/control risks and clawback policy are not actual corrections. Certificate/MOU restatements, share conversions and fund tax reclassifications have distinct scopes. Generic immaterial reclassification wording alone does not prove unchanged revenue or operating income; exact statement comparisons supply the selected-line evidence. In the MOU, the parties expressed their intention to collaborate in a number of areas relating to stablecoins, including exploring, over the three-year term of the MOU, capital market applications for USDC. In addition, we appointed BlackRock as the exclusive manager of USDC reserves during the term of the MOU, other than up to 20% of USDC cash reserves that we may keep in bank deposits.
